mapper.sql: id, owner_id, post_id, object_key, original_filename, media_type, content_type, size_bytes, checksum_sha256, status, processing_status, created_at, confirmed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_media (id, owner_id, post_id, object_key, original_filename, media_type, content_type, size_bytes, checksum_sha256, status, processing_status, created_at, confirmed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ownerId}, #{postId}, #{objectKey}, #{originalFilename}, #{mediaType}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{checksumSha256}, #{status}, #{processingStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{confirmedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM community_media WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId}

SELECT m.id, m.owner_id, m.post_id, m.object_key, m.original_filename, m.media_type, m.content_type, m.size_bytes, m.checksum_sha256, m.status, m.processing_status, m.created_at, m.confirmed_at FROM community_media m LEFT JOIN community_post p ON p.id = m.post_id WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (m.owner_id = #{userId} OR p.status = 'PUBLISHED')
SELECT FROM community_media WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY created_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_media WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND (post_id IS NULL OR post_id = '') AND id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE community_media SET post_id = NULL WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId}
UPDATE community_media SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE community_media SET processing_status = 'READY' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
